name: Tripura State Data Centre (Agartala)
developer: Government of Tripura / National Informatics Centre (NIC)
notes: State government data centre in Agartala (district HQ of West Tripura) hosting state government applications; capacity not disclosed.

name: Agartala Smart City Data Centre (IT Bhavan, Indranagar)
notes: Inaugurated 5 Aug 2024 by Chief Secretary at IT Bhavan, Indranagar; claimed first Smart City Mission data centre in India with own fibre network (156 km); ~Rs 30 crore equipment, 1 PB primary / 1.9 PB secondary storage; city-scale facility, capacity in MW not published.

name: NIXI-CSC International Data Centre (Indranagar, Agartala)
developer: NIXI-CSC Data Services Centre (JV of NIXI and CSC e-Governance Services Ltd)
notes: MoU signed Apr 2022 for an international-standard data centre at IT Bhavan, Indranagar; JV to invest Rs 150 crore, state provides space; planned to host state government data; completion status not verified since.

name: Airtel Data Centre (Agartala)
notes: Land allocation announced by CM Manik Saha at Rising Northeast Investors Summit (May 2025) for upcoming data centres including one by Airtel in Agartala to serve eastern/northeastern India; capacity and timeline not disclosed.

name: Tripura IT & Data Ecosystem Zone / IT Park with AI Centre of Excellence (Agartala)
notes: Proposed 5.81-acre IT and Data Ecosystem Zone in Agartala plus planned 10-acre IT Park with AI Centre of Excellence to house future IT/data investments; announced via Salesforce-Tripura digital workforce collaboration; source page could not be fully loaded, based on search snippet only.

name: VueNow Edge Data Centre (Ambedkarnagar)
notes: Edge data centre inaugurated Dec 2024 (with state IT officials); part of 2021 MoU to deploy up to 750 edge data centres across UP by 2028; size/capacity not disclosed. Caution: VueNow is under an Enforcement Directorate money-laundering investigation (cloud particle scam) and the real extent of its infrastructure is contested.

name: VueNow Edge Data Centre (Ayodhya)
notes: VueNow planned edge data centre in Ayodhya; land acquisition completed as of Dec 2024, no launch timeline announced; part of the UP 750-edge-DC programme. Caution: VueNow is under Enforcement Directorate investigation (cloud particle scam).
